subject.title: fix(gateway): isolate wizard exits from shared process

question: Should Gateway `wizard.start` permanently expose the optional `installDaemon` caller control so external clients that own service lifecycle can explicitly preserve or suppress daemon installation?
rationale: The mechanical implementation and regression coverage are coherent, but the durable public Gateway protocol surface requires maintainer confirmation beyond a contributor-side patch.

options.title: Accept the additive RPC control
options.body: Keep optional `installDaemon` as implemented, preserving omission behavior while allowing embedding clients to own service installation.

options.title: Keep lifecycle isolation only
options.body: Remove the protocol projection and solve daemon ownership through an existing setup or client boundary if maintainers do not want this RPC contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive RPC control
recommendation.body: Keep optional `installDaemon` as implemented, preserving omission behavior while allowing embedding clients to own service installation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-head commits cover the exact Gateway and wizard owner boundaries involved; repository history inspection was unavailable in this read-only environment.
